text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Gadoterate Meglumine Injection administered to healthy volunteers and to adult patients at cumulative doses up to 0.3 mmol/kg was tolerated in a manner similar to lower doses. Adverse reactions to overdosage with Gadoterate Meglumine Injection have not been reported. Gadoterate can be removed from the body by hemodialysis [see Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.3 )] .
